question: Lipidator is a nonionic surfactant that is used to disrupt the lipid membranes of cells. This disruption of the lipid membrane results in the release of all of its cytoplasmic contents. Which of the following viruses would not be disrupted if treated with this detergent?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Lipidator disrupts lipid membranes of cells -> Release of cytoplasmic contents -> Herpesvirus, Hepadnavirus, Flavivirus, Picornavirus, and HIV have lipid envelopes -> Herpesvirus, Hepadnavirus, Flavivirus, and HIV would be disrupted -> Picornavirus lacks a lipid envelope -> Picornavirus would not be disrupted if treated with Lipidator -> 95%
analysis: Hepadnavirus has an outer lipid envelope that surrounds the viral core, which protects it from disruption by Lipidator. Therefore, Hepadnavirus would not be disrupted if treated with this detergent.
